evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models.
